---
title: "Repositories"
---

The repos below are pulled live from GitHub — stars, description, and
language update automatically. The list itself is just the names of your
pinned repos; edit the `pinnedRepos` array below to match whatever you've
pinned on your [GitHub profile](https://github.com/chrystali2002).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pinnedRepos = [
  "Olusegun-Python-Toolkit",
  "ascende-network",
   "nm-app"
  // add more repo names here, exactly as they appear in the GitHub URL
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
repos = Promise.all(
  pinnedRepos.map(name =>
    fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/chrystali2002/${name}`).then(r => r.json())
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`${repos.map(r => `
  <div class="card-block">
    <h3><a href="${r.html_url}" target="_blank">${r.name}</a></h3>
    <p>${r.description ?? "No description provided."}</p>
    <span class="pill">${r.language ?? "—"}</span>
    <span class="pill">★ ${r.stargazers_count}</span>
    <span class="pill">Updated ${new Date(r.updated_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
  </div>
`).join("")}`
```

*If this list doesn't load (e.g. viewing offline), see the [static project highlights](projects.qmd) instead.*
